geographic.draft: Conversation is heavily Metro Manila-centric — Manila, Quezon City, and Makati account for the largest share of geo-tagged mentions. Cebu City is the strongest regional market, consistent with the ZYN Summer Cebu campaign activation. Davao City shows steady organic conversation. Only about 60% of mentions carry geo-tags, so regional volumes are directional rather than absolute. Recommend expanding event activations to Visayas and Mindanao cities where organic interest already exists.

conversation_volume.draft: Weekly mention volume runs a baseline of 20–35 mentions per week, with clear spikes around campaign events. The ZYN Mega Ball 2026 (week of June 9) drove the highest peak at 184 mentions — roughly 513% above baseline. The Summer circuit (Cebu, Siargao, Boracay) created a sustained elevated period from March through May. Volume dips during non-campaign weeks suggest the brand conversation is still heavily event-dependent. Recommend building always-on content to raise the organic baseline.

platform_sentiment.draft: Facebook carries the highest volume share at 37.0%, with a sentiment profile that mirrors the overall brand average. TikTok skews younger and more positive — event content performs especially well here. Instagram shows the highest positive-to-negative ratio, driven by celebrity and lifestyle content. X/Twitter is the most polarized platform with the highest negative share, as health and regulatory discussions concentrate there. Forums carry low volume but disproportionately negative sentiment — this is where detailed health concerns surface. Recommend platform-specific content strategies rather than cross-posting.

narrative_map.draft: The brand-positive narrative stack is anchored by the Mega Ball event series, which generates the highest volume and most positive sentiment of any single topic. Celebrity endorsements provide a reliable secondary positive driver. On the risk side, "underage access concerns" is the single highest-priority narrative — it spiked after the Mega Ball and carries strong anger/disgust emotions. Health risk anxiety is a steady-burn concern that could escalate with any negative news coverage. Price resistance is growing in the August-September period. Recommend addressing the age & legality narrative proactively before it becomes a media story.

top_voices.draft: The top organic voices are dominated by lifestyle and vape-review accounts on TikTok and Facebook. @manila.nightout leads in combined reach and engagement, functioning as an unofficial brand amplifier through event coverage. Pinoy Vape Reviews on YouTube provides the most detailed product commentary. PhilStar Digital carries the highest single-post reach but low engagement — typical of news coverage. No strongly negative top voices appear in the top 10, but Ka-Vape Forum hosts the most detailed health-concern discussions. Recommend engaging the top positive voices with early event access to maximize organic amplification.

share_of_voice.draft: ZYN dominates share of voice at approximately 84% of total conversation volume vs Ploom's 16%. ZYN's advantage is driven by event activations and celebrity partnerships — Ploom's conversation is more product-focused and event-specific (Manila Gin Festival). Ploom's sentiment profile is slightly more positive than ZYN's, likely because it faces less scrutiny on health and age issues due to lower visibility. As Ploom increases its Philippine presence, expect its share of voice to grow. Recommend tracking Ploom's event calendar and influencer partnerships as competitive intelligence.
